title: Juicy Russian Sugar Snap Peas Pilaf
description: A creamy and mustardy Russian dish featuring sugar snap peas, this kid-friendly pilaf is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly and made with katsuramuki-cut sugar snap peas.
instructions: Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the dijon mustard and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Add the uncooked white rice, stir, and reduce heat to low.
Cover the saucepan and simmer for 18 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the sour cream and katsuramuki-cut sugar snap peas.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes or until the peas are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
If using grated cheddar cheese, sprinkle on top and serve hot.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
